*Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about. Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.*

*Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.*

Armageddon, the "Mountain of Assembly," refers to Mt Zion. The valley of Jehoshaphat, the valley of judgment, is the space between Zion and Mt Olive, where Christ will rule during the Millennial Reign.

It is here the armies of the beast assemble and ride out to battle Jesus,
King Of Kings, And Lord Of Lords.

*And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone. And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.*

The antichrist and his false prophet are instantly cast into the lake of fire. The remnant of their armies slain by the sword that comes from the mouth of Christ. The two-edged sword, which immediately calls to mind the word of God. Spoken from Jesus mouth, with the power to slay the wicked, leaving their carcasses for the carrion birds to feed on.

**Jeremiah 7:33**
*And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.*

**Ezekiel 39:17**
*And, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord God; Speak unto every feathered fowl, and to every beast of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, that ye may eat flesh, and drink blood.*

teachings.title: The burden of Babylon and the day of His wrath
teachings.theme: The day of His wrath
teachings.summary: Isaiah's prophecy against Babylon has a dual fulfillment, in the fall of the Babylonian empire and in the destruction of the spirit of Babylon in the wrath to come, when no silver or gold can deliver.
teachings.text:
The prophecy of Isaiah against Babylon, they the day of the Lord is at hand, clearly has dual fulfillment. It speaks not only of the destruction of Babylonian empire, which had only risen to prominence in the days of Isaiah, but that same spirit of Babylon which will be destroyed in the wrath to come.

...*cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it. For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine. And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.*

**Malachi 3:2**
*But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth?*

And as Isaiah preached, the Persians and Medes had no regard for gold and silver, the Lord's judgment can't be swayed either.

**Zephaniah 1:18**
*Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the Lord's wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.*

**Revelation 6:17**
*For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?*

teachings.title: The new Jerusalem in Jeremiah 31
teachings.theme: The new heavens and new earth
teachings.summary: Jeremiah 31 has a dual fulfilment: the return from Babylon and the new Jerusalem in Christ for scattered believers of all nations.
teachings.text:
**Jeremiah 31** picks up immediately after chapter 30; *The fierce anger of the Lord shall not return, until he hath done it, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it.* With God promising His people that their captivity is temporary, a refining process to bring them back to repentance and punish the wicked.

No longer will the iniquity of men be felt by their children. No more men eating sour grapes and their children's teeth being set on edge. We will each stand in Christ or fall to our own sin in a final judgment.

But more, as He does in chapter 31, God gives Jeremiah a prophecy that not only applies to the people in Babylon who will be restored at the end of the 70yrs, but a larger promise to all Israel, and a restoration of a new Jerusalem that encompasses the entire region. That promise, as we see in Hebrews, is in Christ and it is offered to all the scattered believers in all nations, from every shore. And it is a new Jerusalem.

**Revelation 21:16**
 *And the city lieth foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.*

The dual fulfilment of prophecy provides us with a window into the judgment of God and an understanding of His promises and His delivering on them. To give us reason to trust the word of God. And we are blessed to have the revelation of the New Testament to understand what was unclear in the Old. That we who walk in His word may be comforted by faith in His promise and the knowledge of the kingdom to come, in Christ Jesus.

teachings.title: To Him did all prophets give witness
teachings.theme: The new heavens and new earth
teachings.summary: Isaiah 66, quoted throughout the New Testament, encapsulates the believer's hope of a new heaven and earth, Christ's judgment of the wicked, and rest for those who trust Him.
teachings.text:
I'm running late and I will come back to this but in the meantime here are a list of New Testament verses that directly quote or allude to **Isaiah 66**:

**Acts 7:49-50**

**Matthew 5:34-35**

**2 Thessalonians 1:7-8**

**Revelation 19:11-15**

**2 Peter 3:13**

**Revelation 21:1**

**Mark 9:42-48**

A new Heaven and a new Earth, Jesus having the Earth as His footstool. Slaying with the sword that proceedeth out of His mouth. And fiery flame of judgment. And those who trust in Him entering into His rest.

The final chapter of Isaiah, like the final book of the Bible, the Revelation of Jesus, perfectly encapsulates the hope that we have set before us.

To Him did all prophets give witness.

teachings.title: Ezekiel's temple as what could have been
teachings.theme: The new heavens and new earth
teachings.summary: Ezekiel's temple may be read as what could have been, since God with foreknowledge set conditional promises before Israel under the Mosaic covenant, which they failed to keep.
teachings.text:
Here in **Ezekiel 45**, the instructions for a temple and a time where there will be a priesthood of Zadok, Levites given land by cast lots for suburbs around the restored Temple. And sacrifices made for various offerings, the measure of which are given for "just balances," precise volumes, that nothing is cheated or anyone give more than another.

Similar to the existing Levitical laws, given unto Moses, the prophesied Temple in **Ezekiel 40-48** has similar Old Testament offerings and carnal ordinances, Sabbaths and holy days, done away with in the reformation of the New Testament.

We have looked at 4 main theories regarding this prophecy.; that it is symbolic and represents the church in Christ and Jesus our temple.

That it is literal, meant to be the design for the 2nd Temple Ezra will begin after captivity. That they fell short in grandeur and size.

That it is a future Temple, for the 3rd Temple leading up to the beginning of the Tribulation.

That it is a Temple in the millennial Kingdom, or in the eternal Kingdom.

All these theories have problems that make them more and more unlikely to be true. The secret things are His and we see through a glass darkly, but surely there's a purpose and a reason for Ezekiel to cap off his end times prophecies, that extend back to chapter 33. That the restoration promised also applies to the prophecy of the Temple.

Which brings us to another theory which I truthfully hadn't considered before. The interpretation of "what could have been."

First, we must acknowledge that God knows the end from the beginning, and the invisible things of what hasn't happened yet.

**Isaiah 46:9-10**
*Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me, Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure.*

God knows our decisions before we make them, but also allows us the free will to make them, and gives constant appeals to repentance, and encourages us to choose His ways and seek His paths.

The Lord gave the covenant to Israel through Moses with this clear understanding.

**Deuteronomy 30:15-20**
*See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil; In that I command thee this day to love the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the Lord thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it. But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them; I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it. I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live: That thou mayest love the Lord thy God, and that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the Lord sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.*

God made these conditional promises to Israel as a nation, with the foreknowledge that they would fail. Unlike the Abrahamic and Davidic covenants, which were mostly unconditional (depending on the men themselves to believe God, and have it counted for righteousness), the Mosaic covenant, with the commandments and Levitical laws, depended on the people to keep up their end in order to obtain the Kingdom and the promises and the blessings that would come if they would. And in His grace, multiple opportunities for restitution if they failed.

**2 Chronicles 7:14**
*If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.*

teachings.title: Ezekiel's temple: a promise on condition
teachings.theme: The new heavens and new earth
teachings.summary: The temple vision was a conditional promise to Israel of Christ and a kingdom if they repented, which they refused, as Christ lamented over Jerusalem.
teachings.text:
Ezekiel is no different. It is the explicit purpose of the Temple prophecy, giving the people a promise, contingent on their getting right:

**Ezekiel 43:10-11** 
*Thou son of man, shew the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern. And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, shew them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof: and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them*.

The promises given the people included Christ, and a Kingdom, if they repented towards the Law and God.

**Zachariah 6:12-15**
*Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, Behold the man whose name is* The Branch*; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the Lord: Even he shall build the temple of the Lord; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both. And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of the Lord. And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the Lord, and ye shall know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto you. And this shall come to pass, if ye will diligently obey the voice of the Lord your God.*

They could be children of the Kingdom if they were ashamed of their abominations, took the chastening God consistently gave them, and like the heathen of Nineveh, turned from the wicked ways,

God sent prophets, and they killed them. God wiped out the Northern Kingdom as an example. He brings Judah into bondage under Babylon, and makes His holy city desolate. All to goad them to come to repentance that they would be His people, and He would be their God.

**Matthew 23:37**
*O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!*

teachings.title: The White Horse Rider Is the Antichrist
teachings.theme: The Antichrist and the beast
teachings.summary: The first seal's rider on a white horse is the Antichrist imitating Christ, a man of war seeking one world government, the messiah Talmudic Judaism awaits.
teachings.text:
And so the seven seals of the Great Tribulation are unsealed by the Lord Christ Jesus, and at each a portion of the book is opened to reveal to John what is to come.

And he beheld a white horse, and a man, given a crown and carrying a bow who went forth conquering and to conquer. This is the Antichrist. A leader given power and taking more, riding on a white horse, an imitation of Christ.

The Antichrist, and the many antichrists we are to expect in these, the last days, are not only opposed to the true Christ, but come in His place, using messianic claims and imagery. Here it's given that he will be riding a white horse, symbolic of the coming of Christ, so as to fool everyone who is not saved. His weapon, a bow, showing he is a man of war. His goal will be a one world government, a return to the sin of Babel.

In Talmudic Judasism, especially the eschatology of Chabad Lubavitch, their moshiach or "Messiah" will come as a man who is made a king of war who conquers the world, establishing a throne in Jerusalem. Because they literally worship the Beast of the Antichrist. Satan who gives him power.

The second seal is opened and the red horse of war is loosed upon the earth,

Jesus breaks the third seal, and John sees revealed in the book a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand. This is famine. The voice John hears is like a snippet out of time saying "*A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine*."

This is usually interpreted to mean that common commodities, flours of wheat and barley, would be very expensive, a measure, which is a small amount enough to make a single load would cost a penny, which in the Bible usually refers to a days wage for labor.  Taking care not to hurt, or spill or waste, the even-more expensive oil and wine.

The fourth seal is opened, and John is shown a pale horse; *and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him.* This is often called pestilence, but it isn't only disease, but all manner of death, flowing from the first 3 horsemen, the Conqueror, the war and the famine. *And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.*

This is the Great Tribulation preached on by Jesus.

teachings.title: The Beast Promises Peace and Safety
teachings.theme: The Antichrist and the beast
teachings.summary: The beast rises in the beginning of sorrows as a counterfeit Christ promising peace and safety, then blames believers and makes war on the saints.
teachings.text:
**Revelation 13**

*And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.*

*2 And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.*

*3 And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.*

*4 And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?*

*5 And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months.*

*6 And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.*

To continue: At the beginning of the chapter we are told that there is a beast, the rising antichrist who is given power by Satan. This is the man on the white horse, who was going to conquer, armed with a bow. The son of perdition. He comes to power during the Beginning of Sorrows, the first 4 seals, when there are wars and famines, pestilence and earthquakes, afflicting the whole world.

This tribulation brings the beast to prominence, and the fatal wound that is healed brings him to be worshiped along with Satan who granted him his power.

The world will be in crisis, calling out for a savior and be given a counterfeit Christ who promises the apostate world of non-believers peace and safety.

**Jeremiah 6:14**
*They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace*.

**1 Thessalonians 5:3**
*For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.*

And as he is given power to rule all kingdoms of this earth, a one world government, worshiped as a savior, he begins to make war on the saints.

*7 And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.*

*8 And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.*

And as the 5th seal opens in **Revelation 6**, the souls of those slain for their testimony of Jesus Christ begin to appear in Heaven.

The beast will blame believers for the tribulations, turning the world against Christians, and this begins the Great Tribulation which is the war against the saints. We see echoes of this even now. As good as called evil and evil good, those who worship Satan and hate God blame us for everything from climate change destroying the planet, to not taking a jab to "stop the spread" of disease, placing the "blood of millions" on our heads. This is a picture of what's to come in the future.

teachings.title: The False Prophet and the Image of the Beast
teachings.theme: The Antichrist and the beast
teachings.summary: The second beast is the false prophet of a one world religion who makes a speaking image of the Antichrist, so believers should flee idolatry now.
teachings.text:
**Revelation 13**
*11 And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.*

*12 And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.*

*13 And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men,*

*14 And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.*

*15 And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.*

A second beast arises, with the horns of a lamb but the voice of the dragon. This is the false prophet who will be given power by the first beast to make a one world religion that worships the antichrist.

We see in verse 8 that ALL who dwell upon the earth whose names are blotted out of the Book of Life will worship the first beast as a god. Another way of saying this is that those whose names are in the Book of Life, the saved, will not. This is the discernment of the Holy Spirit acting within us. The patience of the saints.

Like Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego who were tempted by Nebuchadnezzar to worship the idol he had decreed all men of Babylon to bow to and refused, willing to be placed in the fiery furnace, so too will the saved by tested.

The second beast, the false prophet who will be the pope of this new world order religion that's formed around its leader as god, will perform what appear to be miracles, calling down fire from heaven.

And he will set up an image of the antichrist to be worshiped. An idol. Beware any religion that allows the worship of idols, now, because they are a picture of this beast religion. Like the jab serving as a picture of the mark, which we are about to discuss, religions of Idolatry are meant to desensitize people over time into accepting this blasphemy. Flee Idolatry.

Not only will the false prophet set up this idol to be worshiped, but he will cause it to move and speak.

**Psalm 115**
*5 They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:*

*6 They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:*

*7 They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.*

*8 They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.*

The Bible tells us again and again how the statues and graven and molten images are as dead and lifeless as the false gods they represent to the idolators. God mocking idolatry as vanity and superstition. And so here, in the holy place of God as the antichrist sits proclaiming himself as God, an image of him is built to be worshiped by the whole world, and in what will be seen as a miracle, the idol will move and speak as if it were alive.

Many consider this the abomination of desolation as spoken of by Daniel, and given us by Jesus as the sign that the Great Tribulation has begun, to be steadfast as His salvation is at hand.

teachings.title: The Mark of the Beast
teachings.theme: The Antichrist and the beast
teachings.summary: The mark of the beast is how the beast system separates believers for slaughter, but that war is cut short by the sixth seal and the rapture.
teachings.text:
**Revelation 13**
*16 And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:*

*17 And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.*

*18 Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six.*

The mark of the beast. The culmination of the one world government and religion of Satan. The way the beast system will separate the goats from the sheep for the slaughter.

In modern times, with the technology we have, digital currency and subdermal chips, we can imagine how this system would work.

Understand the context of its implementation too; wars that have devastated the world, great famines, horrible earthquakes and illness on a massive scale.

Billions must die.

And the false savior given power by Satan and fame from his exploits at war and his mock resurrection, the man of perdition, the antichrist comes forth and is declared ruler, a god emperor, and says that believers are the cause of the calamity. That they refuse to go along with the plan of peace and safety. That they even refuse to worship the beast and take his mark, and so they are the enemy.

And for a period described by the Bible in **Daniel 12** as 75 days, the beast will make war on the saints, and overcome them.

But the Bible promises that this time will be cut short by the 6th seal, the Day of the Lord, the rapture of the saints, the dead raised first then those who are alive and remain at the glorious return of Christ.

teachings.title: The last days and the Olivet question
teachings.theme: Dual fulfillment of prophecy
teachings.summary: We have been in the last days since the Ascension, and the temple's destruction is a separate prophecy from Christ's coming, which dispensationalists and preterists both mix up.
teachings.text:
The idea of dual fulfillment, and a definitions of what constitutes the end times has long been a contentious point.

**2 Peter 3** addresses this, that even in that first century:

*Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.*

Peter goes on to warn against those casting doubts regarding the kingdom to come and the resurrection, who took prophecy as singular, and allegorical, and used that point of view to undermine the faith in the Kingdom promised us in Christ.

According to **Colossians 1:5-6**, the gospel has been preached to the whole world, even at that time. And as Peter notes, and is referenced in other Epistles, the last days have come following the Ascension of Christ. We are living in the end times, and have for 2,000 years if the calendar is to be believed.

What triggered Jesus' discourse was the Apostles wondering at the buildings of the temple, and Jesus prophesying that it would be destroyed, not one stone left upon another. It is after this that they privately ask Jesus, "*Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world*?"

Dispensationalists and others will take the destruction of the temple and add it to the prophecy that follows regarding His second coming and the end of the world, when it is a separate prophecy that spurred the broader discussion.

Preterists will take the same approach, but say all things were fufifiled in 70AD with its destruction.

But fundamentalists, reading in the spirit can see the order of how this is presented in Matthew 24. Rightly dividing the word of God.

teachings.title: This generation shall not pass
teachings.theme: Dual fulfillment of prophecy
teachings.summary: This generation means the generation that sees the signs, not merely the first century or the Jews, and Christ's word that their house is left desolate shows God's wrath on the unbelieving Jews.
teachings.text:
As for the verse following the parable of the fig tree, **Matthew 24:34**, which gives so many trouble;

*Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.*

Jesus has just laid out future prophecy, written to us as much as to the Apostles to whom he preached. (Again, the false doctrine of dispensationalism teaches that this is directed at the Jews, who weren't present and who Jesus refers to as "they," as others, while referring to we, ye the believers, making their interpretation nonsensical.)

So Jesus is preaching of the future generation, present at the time of these signs. Who are reading the times as one could read the fig tree in its due season. This is that generation, which we may be under, or our great grandchildren for that matter. But once the timing of things is made clear to those keeping watch, prepared for the master's return, that generation will not pass until all those things be revealed.

There is dual fulfillment as well, obviously, that the generation of 1st century believers would live to see the destruction in 70AD, but that is not the context of what's given, and those who seek to make it about that have to do contortions to make it fit their doctrine, that the end times is entirely about the Jews.

"God is not finished with the Jews!" Really? In the chapter previous, **Matthew 23**, just before Jesus leaving the temple at the start of this private discourse on Olivette to the apostles, Christ makes it known in no uncertain terms:

*O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not! Behold, your house is left unto you desolate. For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.*

He was through preaching to them that believed not and rejected Him as they rejected the prophets that came before Him. God's wrath abides upon them to the uttermost. From that day forth, an accursed and wicked generation of men.

But they are correct about one thing, God isn't through with them yet. And the Days of Vengeance they who remain, that Synagogue of Satan, will be utterly destroyed.

teachings.title: Take heed: the end is not yet
teachings.theme: The signs of His coming
teachings.summary: In the Olivet discourse Jesus warns that false Christs, wars, disasters and persecution are only the beginning of sorrows and not the sign of His return.
teachings.text:
End times Bible prophecy. The one area of study where we continue to see through a glass darkly. But, for the elects' sake, those of us chosen in Christ, who diligently keep watch, we have been given the knowledge of the signs of the season that we not be caught unawares. That Jesus doesn't come as a thief in the night to those with eyes to see.

And so, here in Mark's version of the Olivette discourse, where Jesus teaches some of the apostles, and by way of the Holy Spirit, teaches ourselves, what will be and what to look for, that we may be ready and be saved, should the great tribulation come in our day.

First, in response to a disciple wondering at the great temple, Jesus says not a stone on top of another will remain standing. This prophecy was fufifiled in 70AD.

Some mistake this as meaning all that follows was fufifiled at that time, which is not supported. Jesus tells us of future events, far outlasting the 1st century, and signs that we have yet to see.

Biblical teaching is that we have been in the "end times" from the moment of Jesus ascension on Pentecost. These are the last days. And until the abomination of desolation is revealed and the sun and moon darkens, that like the fig tree budding signals summer, and Christ returns in His glory in the clouds, as angels gather we elect to join Him,  we shall remain in these, the last days.

And so Jesus begins by warning "*Take heed lest any man deceive you*." There will be false Christs who, if it were possible would deceive even believers. This we have seen throughout history, and witness it today. Many would be Messiahs, especially of the Jew, rising in prominence and power. False prophets and accused fake churches, claiming to be of Christ. Jesus and the apostles warn of this for good reason. *Even now there are many antichrists.* And thus shall it be till the end. *For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.*

*And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet. For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.*

Jesus is still giving warning to not be deceived as to when the end comes. He says we will hear of wars and rumors of wars. Great kingdoms clashing. But we aren't to be troubled, because that's not the sign of His coming. These things are always happening. Same with earthquakes and famines and other tribulations, both man made and naturally occurring, that the superstitious and the fearful seize on to say "this is it! It must be the end of the world!"

Be not troubled, the end is not yet. This is just the beginning of sorrows. These are things that simply are. That must be.

So, he's warned us that we should watch for false Christ's and not be troubled or seek as a sign things like wars and disasters. What the natural man would see as a sign.

And further, as a warning to His disciples, says they are going to be brought before rulers and the Jews of the synagogue of Satan to be persecuted and murdered for His name's sake. And that the Gospel must first be published in every nation. He is still warning them that they not be afraid. That they not take their persecution as the sign that the end is here, and understand that it is a testimony against the rulers of this world and how the Gospel is spread to every creature. He is encouraging them, and us as Christians to understand that this is still the case throughout the last days. First century AD, right up until the end.

Remember the apostles there asked for the signs to know when the day of redemption would be, and so Jesus is laying the groundwork for what NOT to take as a sign that His return was imminent. False Christs, wars and calamity, disasters and famines, the persecution of the saints in the publishing of the Gospel to all nations.

He's saying these things will all happen for sure, but be not troubled, it isn't the end.

teachings.title: This generation shall not pass
teachings.theme: The signs of His coming
teachings.summary: This generation means those alive when the signs come to pass, and dispensationalists twist the verse to obscure the plain meaning of the Olivet discourse.
teachings.text:
And so this is the parable of the fig tree. This is the sign that it's soon. *So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.*

*Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.*

This last verse confuses many. They ignore that this generation refers to the people alive and present when these things come to pass, and instead say that Jesus was speaking directly to the apostles in front of Him and their generation.

It's this confusion and other deliberate distortions of these scriptures that dispensationalists seize on to change the plain meaning of the Olivette discourse regarding the end times. They make it more complicated than it is, and trust those they are misleading won't understand the scripture. Exactly what Christ gave warning to beware.

teachings.title: The 144,000 Are Not Modern Jews
teachings.theme: The 144,000 sealed
teachings.summary: The 144,000 sealed from the tribes are not modern Jews but likely Old Testament saints saved by faith and sent to earth during the wrath.
teachings.text:
And so we had just seen in chapter 6 the opening of the first 6 of 7 seals, revealing the tribulation to come, up unto the return of Jesus Christ, at the opening of the 6th. The sun and moon darkened. The 7th seal, ushering in God's wrath is about to be loosed.

There are 4 angels holding back the winds on earth, from every direction. An unnatural stillness, and a voice in heaven with the seal of the living God says to the 4 angels to hold back the wrath for a moment, as the 144,000 are sealed on their foreheads that they may not be harmed by the wrath to follow.

Note these are not 144,000 Jews. They are 12,000 each of the tribes of Israel we are told, swapping Dan for Manasses, Joseph's son. And they are left on the earth during the time of wrath, sealed against harm.

There is a lot of debate as to what this means and who they are. Are they the remnant of Israel? They aren't  "Jews" or modern Israel, because that apostate country is made up of Turkish muts and Edomite mongrels. So who are they?

Given they arrive on Earth at Jesus return, just as the rapture takes place and the mixed multitudes arrive in Heaven, I am convinced they are Old Testament saints, who have a role to play during the wrath, as we shall see. There haven't been coherent tribes of the 12 patriarchs for millennia. The northern 10 tribes were scattered and almost bred out of existence 700 years before Christ. The remnants of Judah, Levi and Benjamin and the handful of others who escaped the northern kingdom to Judea were scattered in 70 AD. So in order to have this be literal, they would have to be taken from before these events, and would by necessity be saved by faith, utilized by God for this purpose.

It is also possible they are the first to be saved during Jesus ministry, where He came to gather the lost sheep of Israel. It is a dark saying and we can't know exactly.

We can see, however that the vision Ezekiel had is shared by John, and they are describing the same event from different perspectives.

The sealing of the saints in the forehead also is echoed by the beast with his mark. It's very possible that the beast will use **Ezekiel 9** and **Revelation 7** to fool the unsaved into thinking it is just and right to slay those of us believers who will refuse the mark in those days. "They won't be sealed in their foreheads! Put them to the sword!" the antichrist could say, in his counterfeit one world religion, fooling all but the elect.

teachings.title: The Everlasting Gospel Preached Even in Wrath
teachings.theme: The 144,000 sealed
teachings.summary: The 144,000 likely minister during the wrath, and the angel with the everlasting gospel shows a God who offers grace to all, not the god of Calvin.
teachings.text:
Here in chapter 14, we are reintroduced to the 144,000 first described in the parallel passage of Revelation 7, and given added details of who they are and whence they came and the seal upon their heads.

These saints, we are told, come from the 12 tribes of Israel, 12,000 from each, who were believers having the testimony of Christ. Virgins, without guile. We know from chapter 7 they will be sent to Earth during the wrath, coming down from Heaven where they are seen here with Jesus. They are sealed, as we are told in chapter 14, with the name of the living God upon their foreheads. These were redeemed among men, the first fruits unto God and the Lamb, who is Christ.

Again, I believe they are sent to minister during the three and a half years of wrath to those who were not saved prior to the rapture. Those that hadn't taken the mark yet during that 75 days that follows the abomination of desolation and the establishment of the antichrist and his false prophet, until the Day of the Lord.

Remember too, that the two witnesses will be preaching during this time. They who were able to stop the rains and call fire down from Heaven.

(It's interesting to note that the antichrist's false prophet is given power to rain fire by Satan, and will be opposed to the witnesses during this time, much like Jannes and Jambres who withstood Moses in the court of Pharoah, or the prophets )

Even as the grapes of wrath are poured, God would that none perish but come to the saving knowledge of the truth.

John describes seeing an angel flying *in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people, Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.*

This is not the god of Calvin. This is not a god selecting those to save and those to condemn. This is a God who so loved the world that even as He rains hail and sends locusts from Hell to torment those who would not repent, who worship the beast, He offers hope through grace to those who can still choose to have faith.

teachings.title: Abaddon Is the Destroyer Serving God
teachings.theme: The wrath is of God, not Satan
teachings.summary: Abaddon is not Satan but the destroying angel of death who serves God, as in the Passover and at Ornan's threshingfloor.
teachings.text:
As the 5th trumpet sounds, we are told of a star, an angel, that falls from the Heavens to earth, who has the key to Hell, and opens the fiery abyss to free the locust-like creatures to torment mankind. He is identified by John in the Hebrew as "*Abaddon,*" in the Greek, "*Apollyon*," which means "Destroyer."

But who is Abaddon?

Many interpreters say this is Satan, fallen to earth and loosening the beasts of Hell to destroy the unbelieving, but the context given in Revelation creates some issues with this, primarily **Revelation 20:1-3**:

*And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand. And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years, And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.*

See the problem? Also, we know that at the Resurrection, Jesus Himself had the keys to Hell and Death. Would He give them over to that old serpent? Seems unlikely.

And, again, we are witnessing God's wrath with the 7 trumpet judgments, these woes poured upon the earth, and so in all things here, these plagues and the angels who are ministering them, are doing so as servants of God.

This is why, in my opinion, Abaddon is the angel of death. An angel of destruction, working in service to God, and not Satan.

And maybe we have seen the "destroyer" doing God's bidding before;

**1 Chronicles 21:15**
*And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the LORD beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.*

And, perhaps most famously in **Exodus 12:23**:

*For the Lord will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the Lord will pass over the door, and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you.*

This is the destroyer. The angel of death. And to him was given the key to Hell, unleashing the nightmarish beasts, with the power to torment men a span of 5 months, was given unto him.

teachings.title: The Army of the Sixth Trumpet Is God's
teachings.theme: The wrath is of God, not Satan
teachings.summary: As Joel 2 shows, the horsemen of the sixth trumpet are God's army, for Satan is the prince of this world, not the ruler of hell.
teachings.text:
Note the sealed 144,000 are spared the wrath and the woes. And the remaining trees and vegetation, the earth itself is spared. These woes are against man.

And the 6th trumpet sounds and there appears *the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates*.

These 4 angels are followed by two hundred million cavalrymen, riding horses with heads of fire-breathing lions and tails like snakes. And they proceed to kill a third of mankind, making war with the armies of man under control of the beast and the false prophet.

Again, many will say that this is the army of Satan, loosed out of Hell, and that the 4 angels bound are devils, fallen and kept in Hell. But there are problems with this.

**Joel 2** contains a prophecy that pictures these end times events, and clearly the army is God's:

*Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the Lord cometh, for it is nigh at hand;*

*2 A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations.*

*3 A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.*

*4 The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.*

*5 Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.*

*6 Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.*

*7 They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:*

*8 Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.*

*9 They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.*

*10 The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:*

*11 And the Lord shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the Lord is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?*

In the remaining verses of the chapter, God calls on the people facing His wrath, the unbelieving, those worshipping false gods and idols, to turn towards Him and repent. To be saved and given respite from His terrible wrath.

These angels are servants of God. The army is His. Satan never has control over Hell. He never reigns there in scripture. The Bible says those tormented in Hell do so in the presence of the Lord. Judgment is His.

These may be dark sayings and difficult to hear, and the interpretation of the symbolism and literal events being shown the prophets and John may have multiple meanings, short and long term implications, dual fulfilment, etc...But there can be no doubt that this is entirely of God. Not Satan, whose power is only through the men he may deceive, and the temptations and snares of sin he can convince us of in this world. Not of Heaven, not of Hell.

The Bible says Satan is the prince of this world, not the prince of Hell.

teachings.title: The thousand years Satan is bound
teachings.theme: The millennium: Satan bound
teachings.summary: Post-millennialism and amillennialism err because the thousand years is the time Satan is bound after the wrath and Armageddon, which is clearly not now or past.
teachings.text:
Post-millennialism and amillennialism are as unbiblical as pre-trib rapture and dispensationalist Zionism.

The mistake those who adopt the position that either the millennium of Revelation is figurative or worse, currently happening, is that they mistakenly believe the 1000 years refers to Christ's reign, rather than the period of time Satan is bound while Christ rules and reigns with the saints, following the wrath of God being poured out and the battle of Armageddon.

This misunderstanding leads to error. Clearly this millennium isn't now, as Satan is clearly not bound, and is free to deceive men and nations. It's not past, because since Christ there has been no period where Satan wasn't on earth like a *roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour.*

The "it's not literal"/The kingdom means in Heaven/amillennialist approach doesn't account for Satan being loosed at the end of the 1000 years, the battle of Gog and Magog that follows, the total destruction of Heaven and Earth, Hell being thrown into the Lake of Fire, New Heaven and New Earth, etc, or how any of that makes sense if we are all in Heaven and Christ isn't ruling on old, current earth.

teachings.title: He that shall endure unto the end shall be saved
teachings.theme: Enduring to the end
teachings.summary: Enduring to the end refers to believers being delivered from persecution, by death or by His return, not to earning spiritual salvation.
teachings.text:
He gives them, and by inspiration of the word, future believers, the assurance that their persecution will be for God's glory, and that the Holy Ghost will give them what to say as a testimony. Knowing scripture by the Spirit and knowing He brings all things to remembrance that the word of God be made known. It is an assurance, a promise of the Lord.

*Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death. And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.*

Understand the context of that last verse, that it is enduring persecution that Christ promises will occur, that those already saved spiritually will be saved physically. Even if by death of the body. Even if by rapture at His return. We are saved from that persecution. So endure.

This is not a verse on spiritual salvation, and those who try and make it about that intentionally strip it of it's actual context. Don't be fooled.

teachings.title: Watch ye therefore
teachings.theme: Watch and be ready
teachings.summary: Since no man knows the day or hour, believers must watch, stay sober and be faithful stewards so the Lord finds them ready.
teachings.text:
And so, knowing all this, and understanding what to look out for and what to be wary against, what shall we do? Christ tells us.

*But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father. Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.*

*For the Son of Man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch. Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning; Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping. And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.*

Watch. Be prepared. Be sober and vigilant. Not carried away by the cares of this world. Not in fear of the tribulation of this world. Not fooled by false prophets.

We are to watch and be good stewards who sow increase for the Lord. Be like the virgins prepared for the bridegroom, who filled their lamps with oil. Be like a servant left with 10 talents of silver, who increased his master's treasure.

Watch and be ready, that on that great day Jesus greats you saying "well done my trusty servants. Well done."

teachings.title: Revelation Is Written to Reveal
teachings.theme: Preterism refuted
teachings.summary: Revelation is a blessing written to reveal, and its late first century authorship by John undoes the preterist claim that it was fulfilled in 70 AD.
teachings.text:
The revelation of Jesus Christ as told to John, signified by His angel, written to Jesus' servants, and directly to the 7 churches which were in Asia, to tell us the things which John had seen, which are and things which shall be hereafter.

The book of Jesus Christ's Revelation is not written to obscure. Its intent is literally the title. To reveal. Those of us saved by Christ are blessed by reading it. Hearing it. Keeping the prophecy of those things written therein, for the time is at hand.

Written in the late first century, likely around 93AD, by the Apostle John, who  served Jesus in His earthly ministry with his brother James, who was martyred shortly after Christ's ascent. Called by Jesus "Boanerges," or the "sons of thunder," their mother asked Jesus for favor for her sons in **Matthew 20:20-28**.

John was the apostle Jesus loved, who wrote the Gospel and epistles.

Now, exiled to Patmos by Domitian, emperor of Rome from 81 to 96AD, for, as John writes here; "*for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ."* We know the timing and details from John's deciple, Polycarp, and early texts by historians Clement of Alexandria, Victorinus, Eusebius and Jerome.

The timing of its writing doesn't much matter for us, blessed readers. The earthly things are incidental to spiritual. But the heresy of preterism requires the authorship to be pre-70AD, because it relies on the early writing to make the desolation of Judah by Rome, the destruction of the temple and murder and scattering of the Jews, serve as fulfilment of the prophecy.

Other modern "scholars" cast doubt on the author's identity, deny John wrote Revelation, often claiming different people wrote the Gospel, epistles and Revelation attributed to John, however the style and description of spiritual things by the Apostle, as well as the clearly inspired truth contained put that heresy to bed sufficiently for believers. That John's peers and ancient historians testify that it was his bolsters that, but a careful reading of scripture is all we really need.

teachings.title: The Woman Is Allegorical Eve
teachings.theme: The woman of Revelation 12
teachings.summary: The woman of Revelation 12 is neither Mary nor modern Israel but best fits an allegorical Eve, closing the Genesis prophecy.
teachings.text:
There are some who say that if chapter 12 is retelling the birth of Christ then, Mary must be who the woman is. But it doesn't fit with the war on the remnant of her seed, or the timing here, thousands of years after her natural death and going to Heaven to wait for the day of redemption, just like every saved believer.

Some say the crown of 12 stars makes the woman Israel, meaning the modern state of those who call themselves Jews. But this is foolish for numerous reasons, especially the repeated verses about those keeping the testimony of Jesus Christ.

As allegorical Eve, we can see a closure with Genesis through her and the prophecy given by God in the Garden. It makes the most sense to me.

As parable it's not literal and interpretation is given us by the Spirit, comparing scripture with scripture. That's the best we can do with some of the symbolism given in these visions. And that's Ok.

teachings.title: The Feet of Iron and Clay
teachings.theme: Daniel's image and the empires
teachings.summary: The iron mixed with clay in Daniel 2 is the remnant of Rome that clings to power today, from which the ten kingdoms will give the beast his power.
teachings.text:
Without getting too deep into it, I believe that the 7 empires described in Daniel chapter 2, specifically the feet of mixed iron and mirey clay represents where we have been for the past 2000 years. That there is a vestige of the Roman Empire that still clings to power throughout the world, although it's mixed with Myra Clay and isn't fully bonded because of it. And so there are divisions within the kingdoms.

It is from these disparate empires represented by the 10 kingdoms that have an element of Rome still within them, that will end up giving the beast power for the final one world government, the new world order.

The prophecy in Daniel 2 is fascinating. When you consider that the head of gold in the great statute that Nebuchadnezzar dreamed of, represents him and his empire the Babylonians. The following empires, described by Daniel in his interpretation fit perfectly with the empires that followed.

That prophecy held true and is still relevant today thousands of years later. Such is the power of God and his preserved word. Amen

teachings.title: The resurrection is not past already
teachings.theme: The rapture is not past
teachings.summary: The rapture and resurrection of 1 Thessalonians 4 are still to come, and those who deny it or say it is past are like Hymenaeus and Philetus overthrowing the faith.
teachings.text:
**1 Thessalonians 4:16-17**
*For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.*

There are those who teach that there is no rapture, or that if there is, it is past.

**2 Timothy 2:16-19**
*But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness. And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus; Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some. Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.*

Jesus tells us, let no man deceive you. The signs of the times. To be watchful and sober. To be ready. Paul and Peter in their epistles emphasize the importance of patience in awaiting that day, that it will come and to ignore the scoffers and the heretics that seek to undermine the faith in regards to the rapture and the day of the Lord.

These teachings on the end times, what to watch for and what to expect and what to do in the meantime are clear, consistent, and as we saw in our study on **Revelation,** necessary that the will of God be done, that His kingdom come.

teachings.title: Peace and safety, then sudden destruction
teachings.theme: Watching the signs of the times
teachings.summary: False prophets cry peace, but watchful believers know the signs and seasons, while the day of the Lord comes as a thief only on the unready.
teachings.text:
**1 Thessalonians 5:1-3**
*But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you. For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night. For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.*

Jeremiah continues his fire breathing preaching against the people of Judah. And in chapter 8, God's judgment again singles out the false prophets and in this passage, the scribes, for being worthless to the people.

The prophets claiming there is peace in the land and with God. That the abominations the people have committed aren't coming to a head. That the wrath of God wasn't coming.

The scribes, transcribing copies of the law, by the letter and not the spirit, that the people should repent towards God.

God uses the timing of things found in nature, the crane and the storm in their daily migration at dawn and dusk. As the harvest comes in fall when the summer is over.

These signs are ours to see as well. And we who are sober and watchful are given these signs that we may know tribulation is coming for a people.

**Matthew 24:32-33**
*Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.*

The times and seasons are observable to us, but to the backslidden and to the unregenerate, the day of the Lord comes as a thief in the night.

But we know the signs, as Christ told us;

*Take heed that no man deceive you. For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many. And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet. For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.All these are the beginning of sorrows.*

The judgment of nations or the final day of the Lord, the signs and the seasons are known to us, if we remain vigilant and blamelessly walking in the Spirit, ready to be delivered.

teachings.title: End-times Babylon is not Jerusalem
teachings.theme: Mystery Babylon
teachings.summary: Revelation 16 shows Jerusalem divided before Babylon is judged, so they are distinct, and the spirit of Babylon rests on America and the West.
teachings.text:
There is some confusion about what Babylon in Revelation refers to. We see through a glass darkly. But some will claim Jerusalem is end times Babylon based on the similarities between those verses in **Jeremiah 25** and **Revelation 18**.

However we see in **Revelation 16** that this is not the case;

*17 And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.*

*18 And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, and so great.*

*19 And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.*

If we note the order of things, that great city, Jerusalem, is divided in thirds by the catastrophic world-wide earthquake that fells all the great cities, and then God turns to Babylon specifically for destruction.

And it is fitting and proper that God bookends His wrath, bringing the utter destruction and desolation against Babylon that they had brought against Jerusalem. Poetic justice as it were.

In my mind, the spirit of Babylon is upon the United States, and the empire that extends across Europe and in other White nations, Canada, Australia, New Zealand. The Idolatry and profane fornication of a people claiming to be of God, yet wicked in every way. Used to destroy other wicked nations by God, and yet still facing His ultimate judgment just as the original Babylon.

teachings.title: Satan attacks the hope of His coming
teachings.summary: Satan pushes preterism, amillennialism, pre-trib rapture and doubts about Heaven, Hell and the preserved word to rob believers of hope and roots, leaving them withered in tribulation.
teachings.text:
It is the second coming and the rapture of the saints, the resurrection, the promise of being heirs to the Kingdom of Heaven, that Satan attacks with lies, so as to undermine that hope in those who he was unable to keep from salvation. To make those who believed unfruitful. Easily offended in persecution. To render them hopeless, and thus unable to do God's will and save more souls. To make their faith dead, being alone, as they withdraw like the Pharisees who believed on Jesus, but kept quiet for fear of the Jews.

To this end, Satan pushes lies such as the resurrection is past, that it is metaphorical, that the millennium reign is allegory, or already taking place. That the rapture isn't real, the lie that the gathering doesn't appear in scripture, or that it will occur before facing tribulation, so as to make believers be caught unawares.

He attacks the idea of Heaven being our inheritance, of Hell being eternal or real.

Preterism, amillennialism, post millennialism, pre-trib rapture, dispensationalism, "church ages," and other heresy, all designed to undermine our hope and leave us with *no root in ourselves,* on shifting sand. Not established, and so withering when the sun gets to hot.

Too many Christians believe the lie that God's word isn't preserved, that it's too difficult to understand, that they need others to explain every jot and tittle, never spending time in the word themselves. Never growing roots.

These shallow Christians are often carnal, worldly, carried away by the cares of this world. Afraid, angry, unable to show mercy, unable to be fruitful. Having no charity. Substituting the pure religion of being undefiled before God; visiting the fatherless and widows in their affliction, being unspotted from the world, soul winning...they instead cling to meaningless trappings of denomination, the church they attend, the rites and rituals they keep, making big shows of prayer, superficial expressions designed to justify them before man.

And so absent the roots, and not having faith in every Word of God being pure, they are unprepared for tribulations and divisions, and are left hopeless. Withered.

Don't fall into that trap! Don't let Satan snare you. Study to be approved unto God. Prove all things. Comparing scripture with scripture. Grow roots and be established that you may be unmoving in tribulation.

teachings.title: The seed of the woman bruises the serpent's head
teachings.summary: Revelation 12 fulfils Genesis 3: the devil, cast out, wars against the saints in the great tribulation while Christ, bruised on the heel, comes to crush his head.
teachings.text:
A murderer from the beginning, father of lies, the accuser of man before God in Heaven, with enmity with all of mankind, through Eve.

 Waiting to devour man all men, like a ravenous lion, and to devour Christ as soon as He was born though a child of the devil, Herod.

The devil is finally cast out, a 3rd of the host with him, and they fall. Shut out of Heaven and knowing their time short, they begin the great tribulation, to murder as many of *the remnant of the seed which kept the commandments of God and have the testimony of Jesus.*

Christ Jesus, the ruler of a rod of iron. Come to establish the Kingdom. Who, as a man on the cross, was bruised on the heel, but in the resurrection came into glory. Come to bruise that old serpent's head.

The three and a half years of great tribulation begin with his fall.

Because he is a murderer who hates mankind, hates Jesus. Hates God. And his seed are those who do too. Reprobates. They will make war with the saved, sons of God. And they will remain faithful unto death, having overcome in the blood of Christ.

It's one story. Genesis to Revelation.

teachings.title: No Promise of a Third Temple
teachings.summary: Scripture promises no third temple after 70 AD; Scofield invented this teaching, and any sacrifices offered by Christ-rejecting Jews would be an abomination.
teachings.text:
Reaching the midpoint of Revelation, we see John receives a rod made of a reed to measure the temple of God, but not the outer court. This is tied in to the 3rd Temple prophecy, commonly used by the Dispensationalists to say it must be rebuilt at some point before the Great Tribulation begins.

A proof text offered for the building of the 3rd Temple comes from **Haggai 2:7-9**: *And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the Lord of hosts. The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith the Lord of hosts. The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the Lord of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the Lord of hosts*.

Other than this, there is no scripture that promises any new temple will be built in Jerusalem after God used Rome to destroy it in 70AD. Scofield, that viper, is one of the primary sources of this understanding, and his study notes have deceived millions over the past century. Jews in the Tanya, a book of the Chabad Lubavitch Zionist Jews, also claims that Jews will rule the world when the temple is rebuilt and their Moshiach comes.

It's possible. There's obviously attempts to get the Temple Mount cleared of the mosque that currently occupies it. There are fund raising efforts by evangelicals and hyperdispensationalist false prophets, saying they are going to rebuild.

The argument that some form of a temple must be built comes from **Daniel 9:27** regarding the antichrist and the takeover of Jerusalem:

*And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate*.

Basically, the antichrist and the Jews are allies for a year, before he turns on them and will cause offerings of sacrifices to stop, and raise the abomination of desolation in their midst. The argument is, no temple, how could there be sacrifices?

We will see in the second half of Revelation that there will be a New Jerusalem, adorned like a bride and given to Jesus as in a wedding. The old Jerusalem is not really important. As John writes a few verses later, Jerusalem is spiritually called *Sodom and Egypt*, *where also our Lord was crucified.*

God's not a fan.

It is entirely possible the destruction in 70AD and the ceasing of sacrifices and oblations is part of a dual fulfilment. It's difficult to say. We can just go by what is in God's word, and it isn't entirely clear.

One thing that is for certain, if the dispies are correct and the Jews manage to build a 3rd temple and begin making sacrifices there, it will not be pleasing to the Lord. They won't be to Him, as they have not the Son, neither the Father. The sacrifice was always a picture of Christ. If they worship there, it will be itself an abomination and the animals sacrificed to Satan.

teachings.title: The Days of Vengeance on Judea
teachings.summary: In Luke 21 Jesus speaks of the Jews as they and them in the days of vengeance, matching the Gentiles treading Jerusalem in Revelation 11.
teachings.text:
**Luke 21**

2*0 And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.*

*21 Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.*

*22 For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.*

*23 But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.*

*24 And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.*

The Olivette discourse in Luke, which Jesus gives us details of the end times contains this passage regarding the days of vengeance, where those who are within Judea are destroyed. Now. Of course, dual fulfillment aside, this fits in with Revelation 11 and the Gentiles trampling the holy city underfoot.

It's interesting that Jesus refers to these people, they, and them. Talking of the Jews as another, whereas believers He will say thee, ye and thou.

But here Jesus describes the invasion and destruction of the Jews which corresponds with the beast and his armies eliminating them in the end times during the wrath period of the second three and a half years.

teachings.title: The Woman Is Not Modern Israel
teachings.summary: Scofield's teaching that the woman is Israel twists Joseph's dream to prop up a pre-trib rapture and Jewish kingdom, while Revelation mentions Jews only as persecutors.
teachings.text:
Just to reiterate, the Scofield view that the woman is Israel, in order to maintain the Dispensationalist view of end times Bible prophecy, is wrong. Nothing about it fits other than the 12 stars of the crown, the moon and sun, and even that is a stretch.

They use as proof text the story of Joseph and his dreams from **Genesis 37**:

*And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me. And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth? And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.*

This dream puts Joseph as the focus of the worship by his brothers and parents. His father, a man, was Israel. Not a woman. The stars were not a crown. The sun and moon may have been Jacob and Rachel, but again, the presence of a sun and moon as clothing on the woman doesn't work, as Jesus human lineage is through Leah to Judah.

This interpretation doesn't make any sense. But they need it to be modern Israel in order to make the prophecy that follows of a pre-trib rapture and Jewish earthly kingdom, fit. Like most all of their Zionist heresy, they have to take liberties with literal scripture and lean on interpretation of symbolic verses to make it all work. And they will say in no uncertain terms that their interpretation of this chapter and who the woman is as the only correct one.

*Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night. And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death...And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.*

Modern Israel and the Jews who are only mentioned in Revelation in a negative light, as persecuting the saints in a like manner with Satan's war upon believers and are called a Synagogue of Satan. That's it. Every other prophecy and promise is to believers, of every kindred and tongue.

The worship of Jews and their god, Satan, is the entire point of dispensationalism and Scofield's twisted interpretation of the Bible.

teachings.title: Revelation 12 Tells It Three Times
teachings.summary: Revelation intentionally repeats events, and chapter 12 tells the same vision three times, which helps in understanding it.
teachings.text:
One of the difficulties people have with reading the book of Revelation is understanding that several times throughout the book, certain themes or events are repeated, intentionally by God. How the book is split to go over the prophecy given us from 6 to 11, in chapters 12 through 19. And then we're given additional details of the white throne judgment and the new heaven in the new earth in chapters 20 through 22. In a like manner, Revelation 12 tells the same thing three different times.

It's the same vision, but we are given slight changes in detail throughout the chapter that indicate that it tells the story of the woman, travailing im birth, and  the devil seeking to devour her seed. That is Christ, and making war on those who believe on Him.

We can see in verses 1 through 7, 8 through 11 and versus 12 through 17, we see what are essentially the same events told three different times. From the prophecy and birth of Christ to the persecution of the saints in the tribulation after the fall of Satan and his hosts.

It still can be daunting but I have found as I have looked at it with these repetitions in mind, it can become a bit easier to understand.

teachings.title: Faith Over Fear in Great Tribulation
teachings.summary: Facing the beast's war on the saints, believers must trust God rather than their own preparations, love the brethren, and look to Him to provide in the wilderness.
teachings.text:
The moment many were waiting for, the prophecy of the beast, the antichrist and his false prophet. The mark and the number. 666.

The serpent, that old dragon Satan, gives power to the beast, who is mighty and given power to make war on the saints for 3.5 years. 42 months. He is described as having a head wound, and yet lives. A counterfeit Christ. Dead yet risen.

And as he makes war on the saints, those who fight with sword will die by sword, and those who bring others to captivity will be made captive. The beast, the antichrist will have the Uno reverse card and play it often. Testing the patience of the saints. Our faith in Jesus to save us out of Great Tribulation.

This is a hard saying. The Bible tells us again and again that we who keep watch, knowing the signs, staying in the word, won't be taken unawares. But we are expected to lean entirely on the Lord for our salvation from the beast. Not of ourselves.

Just like spiritual salvation. *And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.*

We are to trust God, and not love our own lives, even if it means death of the body. *But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.*

*And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.*

We may die for the cause of Christ and for having His testimony. We may be cut off from buying and selling for refusing the mark of the beast, during a time we are told there will be great famines and pestilences. And all our preparing and stockpiling won't save us. But faith can.

And in that faith, in time of tribulation, whether the normal troubles that we face today, or that Great Tribulation to come, we are to love our brethren in the faith. Caring for one another. Sharing what we have with other saints.

*But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another. And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren... but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more; And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you; That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.*

Having faith that there is a place provided us by God, that we may be nourished...

*And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.*

It's easy to fall into fear at the prospect of being persecuted for our belief. At being cut off by famine and refusing to worship the beast. At being taken unawares and ill prepared. At facing death and starvation. At being cast out into the wilderness.

But there in the wilderness is where God provides. Manna from heaven. Quails in abundance. Locusts and wild honey. Fed by ravens. Water from flint. It takes but faith. The patience He demands of His people.

Faith over fear.

teachings.title: Miry Clay Mingled with Iron
teachings.summary: The miry clay mixed with iron may be false believers, chiefly the Catholic Church and her harlot daughters seeking political power.
teachings.text:
Delving a little bit deeper, we see Daniel talking about the feet of clay mixed with iron in the statue described in the dream. Traditionally in scripture the clay often represents believers. But here it is called mirey clay, contaminated so as to not bind, mixed with iron which is the power of the state,, the remnant of the Roman Empire's power.

This may represent false believers. Those who profess to be Christian but are not and have another gospel, primarily the Catholic Church.

Revelation, as we will see in chapter 17, will describe the whore of Babylon and her harlot daughters. From the description it clearly is the Roman Catholic Church, her harlot daughters the Protestants and various evangelical sects that have splintered off from the whore over the millennia. These churches claiming to be of Christ but seeking political power in the world.

 Mirey clay mingled with iron.
